A '''Mahogany Tree''' is a common [[Trees|tree]] that grows from a [[Mahogany Seed]]. It yields [[Sap]] every day when [[Tapper|tapped]].  It can be chopped down with an [[Axes|axe]], producing 8-13 [[Hardwood]].<ref name="numHardwood" />

[[Mahogany Seed]]s fertilized with [[Tree Fertilizer]] have a 60% chance of growing to the next stage each night, including during [[Winter]]. Unfertilized seeds have a 15% chance of growing to the next stage. This means that unfertilized mahogany trees usually grow in 26±12 days, while fertilized ones usually grow in 7±2 days.

Mahogany Trees may spawn on [[The Mines#Floors (dangerous)|floors 41-69]] of [[The Mines]] when either the [[Quests#List of Mr. Qi's Special Orders|"Danger in the Deep" Quest]] is active or the [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Shrine of Challenge]] is toggled on.
